sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000007-P1, was presented by SANOFI (the Supplier) to Evergreen Health Network 007 on February 8, 2026.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: a Tier 1 rebate of 2%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a commitment of 10 DTaP doses per year.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: awaiting a Customer decision.
